info.title: MowBot API
info.description: API of the MowBot hub. Every client (web, mobile, desktop) uses it.

post.description: Creates the owner account. Requires the setup token printed in the hub logs.
Rotates the refresh token. Native clients send it in the body; web clients send `{}` and rely on the cookie.
Creates a team with its own workspace and shared PC (started on first use).

delete.description: Deletes a team without bots: its PC is removed, its files move to the main team's trash.

post.description: Starts the computer in the background (status `starting`).
Stops the container. Files and home directory are kept.
Gives the calling device the mouse and keyboard; bots' input is paused.

delete.description: Hands the desktop back to the bots.
Moves to `.trash/`. Deleting inside `.trash/` removes the file for good.

get.description: Raw bytes for previews (supports Range). Active types (HTML, scripts) are served as text.

post.description: One-time link `GET /downloads/{ticket}`: the file itself, or a zip when the path is a folder.
multipart/form-data, one or more `file` parts, stored in the `path` folder. Existing names get a ` (n)` suffix.
Renames or moves a file or folder. Fails if the target exists.
One-time ticket for the `GET /events?ticket=…` WebSocket stream.
Adds an LLM endpoint. The API key is sealed at rest and never returned. The first provider is assigned to the bots without one.

get.description: Models advertised by the endpoint. Doubles as a connection test.

post.description: Creates a bot in a team (on the team's PC or a dedicated one) or solo (own PC and workspace).

delete.description: Deletes a bot (not the Chef) and its conversation. A dedicated PC goes with it; a solo bot's files move to the main team's trash.

patch.description: Identity, mission, provider and model of a bot.

get.description: Conversation with the bot, newest page first (items are oldest → newest).

post.description: Posts a message to the bot. Its answer streams through `message.delta` / `message.updated` events.

delete.description: Starts the conversation over: stops the bot, deletes its messages and closes what it left open on its computer. Workspace files are kept.

get.description: Most recently updated first (200 at most).

post.description: Gives a task to a bot, which is woken up to do it.

patch.description: A status change is reported to the bot doing the task.

get.description: What bots write to each other, newest page first (items oldest → newest).
